title: TARDIS Regeneration
description: Travel through time and space with your TARDIS, regenerate like a Time Lord, and shape your own adventure. Complete freedom.
body:
# TARDIS Regeneration

A modpack that combines [TARDIS](https://modrinth.com/mod/ait) and [Regeneration](https://modrinth.com/mod/regeneration) mod. It adds a fully functional **TARDIS with time travel, dimensions, interiors, controls, and more**, along with a **regeneration system**.

For detailed tutorials, please check each mod’s wiki for the appropriate mod.

**Includes QoL mods.**

This modpack has **no quests, no progression goals, and no required objectives** — play however you want.

**Multiplayer compatible.**
